lines.text: A fugitive from Jerusalem tells Ezekiel the city has been taken, and the LORD opens Ezekiel's mouth before he arrives.
The people in the ruins say Abraham was only one man, but they are many, so the land is theirs.
God says those in the ruins fall by the sword, those in the open field by wild animals, those in caves by famine.
Ezekiel's people talk about him near the city gates, and they hear his words but do not practice them.
Ezekiel is like a singer of love songs to them, and when it comes to pass they will know a prophet was there.
